text: The Company has a line of credit with a bank. They can borrow up to $10,000 during the year. They must borrow and repay in $1,000 increments. Interest expense on the line of credit is equal to 1% of the line of credit balance at the end of the previous month. Minimum cash balance of $2,000 is required. Remember: The company also purchased $1,000 of equipment on January 1, 2024.
